ownerStatement: Bring Beat Slicer live. I waive the static cycle bound and the MIDI flood for this version.
reason: The popup's draw cost was measured on the owner's MKII (about 1 ms a UI tick, 6 % of the CPU, only while it is open) and stands as the bound on record; no static count was made. Beat Slicer has no MIDI path, so no flood ran. Every other qualification stays required.
